title: Nahor's Family and the Birth of Rebekah
description: After this, Abraham was told that Milcah had borne eight sons to his brother Nahor: Uz, Buz, Kemuel (the father of Aram), Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel—Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. In addition, Reumah bore four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah. This genealogy points forward to Rebekah, who later becomes Isaac's wife.
